_comment: Freelance / ZZP assignment sources for the SEPARATE freelance lane. The candidate has a Dutch sole proprietorship (eenmanszaak) and can invoice, so contract/interim/ZZP work is DESIRED here (the full-time lane's fixed_term/consultancy filters are bypassed for this lane). Scope: Netherlands + NL-billable remote. Roles: data / BI / analytics / business analyst — NOT senior Data Scientist / Data Engineer. Reliability tiers below are honest: 'high' = scraped automatically via a stable endpoint; 'medium' = best-effort public-listing HTML scrape (can break if the site changes); 'manual' = login-gated / anti-bot, registered for reference only — paste a specific public listing URL into `manual_urls` to have the scanner fetch it.

location_scope.note: Netherlands cities + NL-based remote. DE/TR are out of scope for freelance.

linkedin.note: Reuses the existing LinkedIn guest jobs endpoint with the Contract/Temporary job-type filter (f_JT=C,T) over NL locations + a remote pass (f_WT=2). Same code path as the full-time scan — the most reliable freelance source.
